saw_lines: Enterprise buyers of AI agents ask who is accountable first, and IT often signs off before a team sees a demo.
So the IT question has to be answered in the first line, or the team lead never reaches the demo.
Your only live ad carries no proof number, so collect one, a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next ad with it, not the story.
